rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose way to say that something gives someone great pleasure.

example.english: This gift gives me great delight.
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 lai5 mat6 ling6 ngo5 hou2 hoi1 sam1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for pleasure or an enjoyable thing, including an activity that gives someone pleasure.

example.english: Watching the children learn new things is a real delight.
example.traditional: 睇住啲小朋友學識新嘢，真係好有樂趣。
example.jyutping: tai2 zyu6 di1 siu2 pang4 jau5 hok6 sik1 san1 je5 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 lok6 ceoi3

rows.note: Use this more formal noun for the feeling of joy or delight itself, especially in written or elevated contexts.

example.english: This poem conveys a deep sense of delight in life.
example.traditional: 呢首詩充滿對生命嘅喜悅。
example.jyutping: ni1 sau2 si1 cung1 mun5 deoi3 sang1 ming6 ge3 hei2 jyut6

rows.note: Use this when someone takes pleasure in an experience, activity, or another person's company.

example.english: I delight in having dinner with my family.
example.traditional: 我好享受同屋企人一齊食飯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 hoeng2 sau6 tung4 uk1 kei2 jan4 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase for a thing, activity, or experience that makes someone happy rather than for joy itself.

example.english: There were lots of things that brought us delight on this trip.
example.traditional: 呢次旅行有好多開心嘢。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 leoi5 hang4 jau5 hou2 do1 hoi1 sam1 je5
